text: The Quarterly Dashboard Results report from the Chief Executive Officer was launched in December 2017 in support of our strategy to improve communications with the Board and the public. This information report provides the status of seven Key Performance Indicia (KPI's) address the Goals and Objectives of the 2017 - 2019 Strategic Plan.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place received the report (March 8, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
